title: Tencent officially launches HunYuan Hy3: 295B-param MoE model, 90% agent task resolution, integrated across ~50 products including WeChat and Yuanbao
summary: Tencent's Hunyuan team officially released Hy3 on July 6–7, 2026: a 295B-parameter (21B activated) Mixture-of-Experts reasoning model with 256K context. Benchmarks show 90% agent task resolution on WorkBuddy (up from 72% with the preview), surpassing DeepSeek V4 Pro and Qwen 3.7 Max on key evals. Pricing: 1 yuan/M input tokens, 4 yuan/M output tokens. Already integrated into WorkBuddy, CodeBuddy, Yuanbao, ima, QQ Browser and ~40 more products.
why: 腾讯正式跻身顶级推理模型阵营，混元Hy3性能基准超越DeepSeek V4 Pro；当天0700.HK股价上涨约5.6%至477港元附近，显示市场对腾讯AI商业化给予积极定价。对于持有腾讯期权仓位的投资者，隐含波动率短期可能偏高，covered call或宽跨式可考虑在本轮反弹高位操作。

title: Tesla (TSLA) surges +6.7% on July 6 to close at $419.77 as Miami Robotaxi launch boosts investor sentiment
summary: TSLA closed at $419.77 on July 6, up 6.7%, as investors digested the Miami Robotaxi launch — first unsupervised commercial deployment outside Texas. Morgan Stanley raised its Robotaxi fleet forecast to 1,500 vehicles by year-end and 30,000 by 2030. Miami deployment covers western/central Miami-Dade (excluding downtown), with Phoenix, Orlando, Tampa and Las Vegas expansions expected by year-end.
why: TSLA单日+6.7%，收于$419.77，短期Robotaxi催化剂清晰。对持有TSLA卖出看跌仓位的投资者：当前股价远离低执行价风险区，隐含波动率可能因消息驱动短暂走高，是滚动期权/平仓获利的窗口；需注意Morgan Stanley扩张预测是否已充分定价。

title: Gold retreats to ~$4,147/oz from 2-week highs as USD strengthens; Fed rate-hike risk caps precious metals upside
summary: Gold fell to approximately $4,147.94/oz on July 7, down ~0.4% from prior session and pulling back from 2-week highs. A firming US dollar and elevated probability of a Fed rate hike at the July 28–29 FOMC meeting are limiting upside. Gold remains up ~26% year-on-year but has dropped ~4% over the past month.
why: 黄金在4100-4200美元区间高位整理：美元走强+美联储加息风险压制金价，直接影响老铺黄金(6181.HK)的金价叙事。若金价跌破4000美元，古法金首饰需求可能受压，需关注老铺黄金下行风险；同时黄金高位回调对A股/港股黄金板块也有连带影响。

title: Trump renews IEEPA-style tariff investigations against China, EU, Japan, India and Taiwan — second-wave trade war risk rises
summary: The Trump administration has ordered new Section 301 / IEEPA-style investigations into major trading partners — China, EU, India, Japan and Taiwan — alleging excess manufacturing capacity. Potential additional tariffs could layer on top of existing levies. US-China trade has already fallen ~30% since the first tariff round; fresh measures risk disrupting supply chains further.
why: 新一轮关税调查威胁中美、中欧贸易链：对拼多多Temu出海（成本上升）、小米欧洲智能手机销售、海底捞海外扩张（特海国际）均有潜在负面影响；美国对台湾的调查可能波及台积电供应链，间接影响英伟达/AMD供货时间表；卖出期权策略需在相关标的上保持更宽安全边际。

title: A股7月进入财报披露季：定价逻辑从「景气预期」转向「景气确认」，沪深300约4842点
summary: 随着7月正式开启，A股将进入Q2财报密集披露期。市场分析认为，投资者定价逻辑将从「景气预期」切换至「景气确认」：凡实际业绩不及预期的标的面临补跌压力，超预期个股则有望获得补涨。沪深300截至7月初约4842点，较近期高位有所回落。
why: A股财报季开启，持有消费+科技赛道的中长期仓位需注意业绩兑现风险：关注好未来(TAL)7月披露节点，以及拼多多/阿里等中概龙头Q2指引；卖出期权策略的标的若Q2业绩有不确定性，建议在财报前降低delta敞口或选择更虚值执行价。

title: Q2 2026 US earnings season kicks off this week: Major banks report July 11–15; S&P 500 total earnings expected +10% YoY
summary: PepsiCo opens the unofficial Q2 earnings season July 9, followed by Delta Air Lines July 10. Major financials week begins July 11 with Citi and Wells Fargo, Morgan Stanley July 14, JPMorgan Chase July 15. JPM consensus: ~$5.49 EPS on ~$48.7B revenue (+10.5% and +5.2% YoY respectively). S&P 500 broad Q2 earnings expected +10% YoY, with investment banking and trading franchises leading.
why: Q2财报季正式开幕：大型银行业绩将为市场定调，若业绩超预期叠加降息预期升温，科技+消费板块可能进一步走强，持有谷歌/英伟达等US标的卖出期权时隐含波动率需关注；财报高峰期（7月15日前后）建议避免在即将披露标的上建立新的裸卖期权仓位。

title: SK Hynix reportedly secures ~70% of Nvidia's HBM4 orders for Vera Rubin platform; HBM4 shortage expected to worsen in H2 2026
summary: SK Hynix has reportedly captured approximately 70% of Nvidia's HBM4 high-bandwidth memory orders for the Vera Rubin AI platform, outpacing Samsung and Micron in Nvidia's qualification process. SK Hynix has been shipping paid HBM4 samples to Nvidia since September 2025 with excellent yield rates, and the company warns HBM4 supply shortage will worsen through H2 2026 as demand surges.
why: SK海力士垄断约70% Nvidia Rubin HBM4订单，HBM4供给将持续偏紧：利好SK海力士H股（7709.HK），南方两倍做多SK海力士ETF（CSOP）持仓价值上升；HBM4短缺预期可能推高相关AI算力标的隐含波动率，包括英伟达期权。

title: Intel 18A-P enters risk production at VLSI Symposium: 9% performance gain or 18% power reduction vs 18A; Apple, Nvidia, SoftBank as anchor customers
summary: Intel announced 18A-P entering risk production. 18A-P delivers 9% higher performance at iso-power or 18% lower power at iso-performance vs the base 18A node, alongside 20–40% improved thermal resistance. Nvidia, SoftBank, Google and the US government are named as partners and customers supporting the Intel Foundry roadmap.
why: Intel 18A-P进入风险量产，代工业务拐点确认信号：若英伟达、苹果实际流片成功，INTC代工估值重估可能落地；短期仍属「风险量产」阶段，距正式量产和盈利贡献尚需时日，建议以中长线持仓态度关注而非追涨。

title: Micron (MU) gets bullish Wall Street boost: Jensen Huang calls MU an 'indispensable partner'; analysts raise targets after record Q3 FY2026
summary: Following Micron's record-breaking Q3 FY2026 (revenue $41.46B, net income $28.24B), Jensen Huang publicly endorsed Micron as a key partner for Nvidia's HBM roadmap. Multiple Wall Street analysts raised price targets in early July 2026. MU has advanced over 240% year-to-date, making it one of the best-performing S&P 500 stocks. Micron has signed 16 multiyear supply agreements with binding commitments.
why: 美光Q3创纪录业绩叠加Jensen背书，HBM/DRAM超级周期持续验证；对持有两倍做多美光ETF仓位者是直接利好；需注意240%涨幅已消化大量预期，财报披露期后隐含波动率可能收缩，covered call策略有望获取时间价值。

title: Palantir launches NVIDIA Nemotron engine for US government: AIP + Foundry now deploys sovereign AI in air-gapped classified networks
summary: Palantir Technologies announced (June 29) an initiative with NVIDIA to deploy Nemotron open models within Palantir's AIP, Foundry, Ontology and Apollo platforms for US government agencies and critical infrastructure. The joint offering enables agencies to run and fine-tune AI in air-gapped and classified environments with full data sovereignty. The sovereign AI market is projected to reach $600B by 2030.
why: Palantir绑定Nvidia Nemotron进军主权AI，国防+政府合同护城河进一步加深；PLTR近期已获多项大型国防合同（美国陆军NGC2等），Nemotron合作增强可持续收入确定性；对于持有PLTR的投资者，政府AI合同规模化是长期估值支撑，短期可考虑在相对高位适度卖出covered call。

title: Futu moomoo launches 'Moomoo Engine' (July 2): unified research + options + trading toolkit at $3.99/month
summary: Moomoo (Futu Holdings, FUTU) launched 'Moomoo Engine' on July 2, 2026 — a paid subscription ($3.99/month, $0.99/month for accounts >$1,000) bundling three engines: Fundamental Engine (7 research tools + AI briefings), Options Engine (Level 2 options data, strategy lab, P&L simulator, gamma exposure, unusual activity alerts, no-code algo trading), and Technical Engine (Level 3 order depth, volume profile, backtester, pro charts).
why: moomoo Engine的期权引擎（Level 2期权数据、策略实验室、盈亏模拟器、伽马敞口跟踪）与投资者sell put/covered call策略高度契合；富途Q1收入+25% YoY至7.47亿美元，客户资产同比+47%，Engine付费化有望提升ARPU；对于持有FUTU的投资者，产品货币化是估值重估的催化剂。

title: 港股恒指7月18日涨1.3%至25009点，科技消费股集体拉升
summary: 受美国6月CPI超预期降温提振，港股恒指7月18日上涨约1.3%收报25,009点。持仓个股全面走强：腾讯+2.1%、美团+4.9%、小米+6.2%、泡泡玛特+6.9%、快手+5.6%。
why: 持仓港股集体拉升，卖出期权delta风险下降；美联储加息预期持续回落有利估值修复，中期偏多。

title: US June CPI Cools Sharply: Core MoM Flat, Fed July Hike Odds Collapse to 17%
summary: June headline CPI fell 0.1% MoM (+3.5% YoY); core CPI was flat 0% MoM vs 0.2% expected. Treasury yields slid sharply. Markets price only 17% probability of a Fed hike at the July 29 FOMC meeting vs 42% the prior day.
why: 通胀超预期降温是港股/美股本周反弹的核心驱动；若7月29日FOMC按兵不动，成长股估值支撑进一步夯实，期权卖方偏有利。

title: China Q2 GDP Misses 5% Target at 4.3% — Weakest Growth in Over 3 Years
summary: China's Q2 2026 GDP expanded 4.3% YoY, missing both the 4.5% consensus and the government's ~5% target — first miss since pre-pandemic. H1 GDP was 4.7%. Urban fixed-asset investment fell 5.7% H1; retail sales rebounded 1% in June after -0.6% in May.
why: GDP增速低于目标强化市场对刺激政策的押注，但内需疲软对消费类持仓（美团、携程、海底捞）构成基本面压力，需跟踪政策响应。

title: US Revokes Iran Oil Waiver After Hormuz Attacks; Brent Rebounds Above $76
summary: The US revoked Iran's temporary oil export waiver (valid to Aug 21) after attacks on three commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz. Brent crude rebounded over 3% to ~$76.48/bbl. Iran threatened decisive actions. Sanctions now bar Iranian oil transactions effective July 17.
why: 油价反弹压通胀预期，可能推迟美联储降息时间表；地缘风险上升对全球风险资产构成阻力，卖出期权需注意波动率抬升风险。

title: Circle Wins OCC National Trust Bank Charter; GENIUS Act Stablecoin Framework Goes Live July 18
summary: Circle (CRCL) received final OCC approval July 10 to establish Circle National Trust Bank, enabling direct USDC reserve management. The GENIUS Act's one-year implementation period expires July 18, requiring federal agencies to issue stablecoin rules. USDC in circulation exceeds $73 billion.
why: 直接利好Circle CRCL持仓：銀行牌照+GENIUS Act落地双重催化提升USDC制度地位，加速机构采用，长期持股逻辑更稳固。

title: GENIUS Act July 18 Regulatory Deadline: Six Federal Agencies Must Now Publish Stablecoin Rules
summary: As of July 18, the Fed, OCC, FDIC, NCUA, CFTC, and SEC must publish implementing rules under the GENIUS Act for payment stablecoins. CRCL shares came under pressure amid uncertainty over whether new reserve, disclosure, or licensing standards will emerge. Circle preemptively secured OCC bank charter July 10.
why: GENIUS Act规则落地方式直接影响Circle CRCL合规成本与竞争格局；规则若宽松则股价反弹，若趋严则短期承压——是本周关键事件风险。

title: 金价半年跌超28%，老铺黄金市值较高点蒸发逾1200亿港元，估值回落至12倍PE
summary: 国际金价较年初高点下跌超28%，老铺黄金（6181.HK）市值较历史峰值蒸发逾1200亿港元。记者实探显示多地门店客流稀疏，二手市场折价，部分门店已上架按克重计价产品；估值从约50倍PE跌至约12倍，已接近周大福、老凤祥等传统金店水平。
why: 金价大幅下行重塑老铺估值逻辑，东方硬奢溢价模式遭严峻考验；若有卖出期权敞口需评估下行风险，或考虑调低行权价。

title: 京东AI Agent与腾讯元宝打通小程序生态，混元Hy3日均Token消耗量较前代20倍
summary: 7月15日，京东AI Agent与腾讯元宝完成小程序生态集成，支持购物推荐、售后等场景。腾讯7月6日已正式发布混元Hy3，日均Token消耗量较前代20倍；微信AI Agent小薇灰测中，依托14亿月活用户与百万级小程序生态。
why: 元宝生态扩张与微信Agent落地是腾讯 AI从研发向变现转化的早期信号，巩固0700.HK中长期持仓逻辑；Sell put存续期内基本面改善中。

title: GOOGL Q2 2026 Earnings Due July 22: Google Cloud +63% YoY Expected; Gemini 3.5 Pro Launched
summary: Alphabet reports Q2 2026 after close July 22 (call 4:30 PM ET). Analysts project revenue ~$118B and Google Cloud growth ~63% YoY — after Q1's record $20B Cloud quarter at 63% growth and 32.9% operating margin. Gemini 3.5 Pro launched July 17. EPS consensus ~$2.87-$2.95.
why: GOOGL持仓7月22日财报为核心催化剂；云业务若延续63%增速将大幅提振估值，报告前隐波或抬升，需评估是否调整covered call策略。

title: Tesla Q2 Deliveries Hit Record 480K, Beating 406K Estimate — Earnings Call July 22
summary: Tesla delivered 480,126 vehicles in Q2 2026, beating analyst estimates of ~406K by 18%. Energy storage surged to 13.5 GWh. Q2 earnings call set July 22 at 5:30 PM ET. Revenue expected ~$25.3B (+12% YoY); EPS consensus ~$0.50.
why: TSLA持仓交付量大幅超预期；7月22日财报为期权事件，若FSD/Robotaxi变现指引强劲将强化多头；注意财报前隐波上升压力。

title: Tesla Robotaxi Goes Fully Unsupervised in Miami — Now Live in 4 Cities With No Safety Driver
summary: Tesla's fully unsupervised Model Y Robotaxi expanded to Miami on July 16, joining Austin, Dallas and Houston. No driver or safety monitor inside. The Miami service area covers western/central Miami-Dade. Waymo operates in 5 states vs Tesla's 2 states and 4 markets.
why: Robotaxi持续商业落地兑现马斯克自动驾驶估值叙事；每新增城市提升确信度，利好TSLA中期持仓；财报前（7月22日）Robotaxi进展或进一步压缩隐波下行空间。

title: Palantir-Nvidia Announce Sovereign AI Plan for US Military; PLTR Surges 24% to $133
summary: Palantir and Nvidia unveiled a sovereign AI initiative to deploy Nvidia Nemotron models in secure environments for US government and critical infrastructure. PLTR Q1 2026 revenue was $1.633B (+85% YoY). Stock surged ~24% from $107 to $133 on the announcement.
why: PLTR持仓政府AI合同+商业AI双线推进，股价急升验证军事AI护城河；+85%营收增速支撑高倍估值，期权卖方需注意高波动性风险。

title: SK Hynix Raises Record $26.5B on Nasdaq Debut (SKHY); Holds 58% HBM Market Share
summary: SK Hynix raised $26.5 billion in the largest-ever U.S. listing by a foreign company on July 10 (ticker: SKHY), closing its first day at $168.01 (+13% vs $149 IPO price). Holds 58% global HBM market share. UBS forecasts ~70% SK Hynix share in HBM4 for Nvidia's Rubin platform.
why: SK海力士NASDAQ上市提升HBM供应链整体能见度；HBM4垄断地位对英伟达持仓的供应链稳定性是正面信号；也影响美光HBM竞争格局判断。
